design.title: Multi-Project Management — Projects Page + Central Registry
design.summary: Add a global project registry (~/.awsl/projects.json) and a Projects page in the dashboard to manage multiple projects from one place. Each project keeps its own .planning/ directory. Dashboard reads all registered projects' status. Cross-project queue operations work by spawning detached awsl processes.

dataModel.ProjectEntry: { name, path (unique key), addedAt, lastActiveAt?, tags?, engine? }
dataModel.ProjectStatus: { name, path, exists, hasPlanning, isLocked, queue: {pending,running,done,failed,total}, lastRun?: {date,status,goal,duration} }

apiEndpoints.GET /api/projects: List all projects with live status
apiEndpoints.POST /api/projects/queue/add: Add task to project queue { path, goal }

cliCommands.awsl projects: List all registered projects with status

keyDecisions.project_identity: Absolute path is unique key, name is display label
keyDecisions.cross_project_queue_start: Spawn detached child process 'awsl queue start --cwd <path>'
keyDecisions.no_shared_queue: Each project keeps its own queue, dashboard is unified view only
